_comment: EXAMPLE · StarRocks destination / write modes — the destination that CANNOT CREATE ITS TARGET. The connector only issues TRUNCATE (replace) plus INSERT INTO <t> (<cols>) SELECT * FROM FILES(...), so the targets must already exist and the frames must match their DDL: this suite writes world-shaped rows into the `city` and `country` tables the world model seeded in the backing domain. The Primary Key model then decides which mode goes where — city.id is AUTO_INCREMENT and the frame omits it, so append gets FRESH keys and the count GROWS; country's key is `code`, so appending the same codes would upsert in place, which is why replace targets that one (and truncates the 239 seeded countries away). write_nothing shows a returned None staging nothing and NOT truncating. schema_evolution="iceberg" is deliberately NOT exercised: the INSERT ... SELECT FROM FILES path does not pre-ALTER the target, so a widened frame fails on column count rather than evolving. Staging is via S3 here; the _gcs and _az templates are the same connector with a different staging store. One function per file under functions/starrocks_dest_modes/. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite examples/starrocks_dest_modes --keep`.
